title: Oximemo PDC migration report (per document)
description: Machine-readable per-document report emitted by the Oximemo PDC dry-run importers and updated by user-authorized conversion. Pinned to the Markdown-first PDC 2 pivot (upstream commit 0ee51ea, tag v2.0.0-draft.2; see docs/PDC-MIGRATION.md); the schema identifier and existing fields stay frozen, additions are compatible, renames or removals require a new schema identifier.

source.description: Vault-relative path of the legacy source document.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source bytes the findings describe; guards later replacement.

target.description: Vault-relative candidate path. Conversion writes here first; the source is replaced only after explicit user authorization.

document_id.description: Canonical PDC UUID for the converted document: the preserved legacy UUID or the allocated UUIDv7.

decision.description: Conversion replaces the source only after an explicit user decision recorded here.

kind.description: safe: lossless mapping exists. ambiguous: more than one target interpretation. unsafe: construct fails the HTML/profile safety checks. externalized: value moved to a managed asset or extension map. unsupported: construct cannot survive conversion; source must stay readable.

location.description: Line reference or selector inside the source document.

action.description: What the importer did or proposes to do about this finding.
